lead.event: Indonesia and EU sign the IEU-CEPA and Investment Protection Agreement
lead.headline: Indonesia and EU sign IEU-CEPA and IPA, with zero tariffs on 90.4% of Indonesian tariff lines
lead.blurb: Indonesia will open 98.49% of its 11,419 tariff lines, with 78.6% set at zero tariffs upon entry into force, under the agreements signed in Brussels on 21 November by Airlangga Hartarto and EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič. They are targeted to take effect on 1 January 2027, subject to ratification by both parliaments and domestic legal procedures.

macro_flows.event: Rupiah record low, continued weakness, and Bank Indonesia’s defense measures
macro_flows.headline: Rupiah JISDOR hits record low at Rp18,278 as BI raises rate to 6%
macro_flows.blurb: BI said its swap and DNDF hedging incentives had generated roughly US$14.1 billion in domestic transactions through 17 November. It also intervenes offshore through NDFs and domestically through spot and DNDF transactions. Analysts forecast further weakness on 23 November, with projections ranging from Rp18,220 to Rp18,330 per US dollar.
macro_flows.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Domestic hedging transactions generated roughly US$14.1 billion through 17 November 2026.

macro_flows.event: Bank Indonesia rate increase and effects on BTN and BCA mortgage credit quality
macro_flows.headline: Bank Indonesia raises rate to 6% as mortgage credit quality faces pressure
macro_flows.blurb: Property-loan NPL reached 3.38% in September 2026, up from 3.31% a year earlier, while growth slowed to 4.33%. BTN expects overall NPL of 2.8%–2.9% through end-2026, while BCA reported overall NPL of 1.8% and offers long fixed-rate periods to help borrowers manage floating-rate transitions.

market_structure_policy.event: SMBC Indonesia plan to go private and delist from the IDX
market_structure_policy.headline: BTPN plans to go private and delist all shares
market_structure_policy.blurb: Bank SMBC Indonesia shares closed down 2.9% at Rp2,340 per share in the latest trading session. The bank submitted its plan to hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting for approval by the OJK and IDX, with detailed explanations due alongside the meeting announcement on 30 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BTPN shares closed down 2.9% at Rp2,340 per share in the latest trading session.

earnings_guidance.event: UOB Kay Hian estimates ADRO’s dividend payout
earnings_guidance.headline: UOB Kay Hian estimates ADRO dividend after US$517 million profit through September
earnings_guidance.blurb: UOB Kay Hian expects Alamtri Resources to pay a large dividend, citing net profit of US$517 million through September, up 71% year on year. Its aluminium subsidiary targets 370,000 tons of production and 300,000-340,000 tons of sales in 2026, which is expected to further boost Q4 performance.

earnings_guidance.event: SILO reports nine-month 2026 results and outlook for acquisition-related interest costs
earnings_guidance.headline: SILO reports 22% nine-month profit growth as analysts flag about Rp150 billion in interest
earnings_guidance.blurb: Siloam's revenue rose 11.3% to Rp10.49 trillion and net profit reached Rp929 billion through Q3-2026. It completed the first stage of its First REITs acquisition, eight properties worth about Rp4.1 trillion, in September-October, with six more properties worth an estimated Rp2.8 trillion targeted by Q1-2027.
